listing.name: Wario Land 4 (BioRhythmic Studios)
listing.summary: An unofficial native PC port of Wario Land 4. Upstream offers Windows and Linux x64 beta packages. Its launcher needs your own unmodified US Game Boy Advance ROM.

steps.title: Open the upstream launcher
steps.instruction: On Windows, select the Windows x64 release, extract the entire ZIP into a folder you own, and open wl4-launcher.exe. Keep both EXEs, SDL3.dll, and the notices together. On Linux x64, select the separate Linux AppImage release. Make the AppImage executable and open it with glibc 2.38 or later. Follow the Linux guide if the host cannot use FUSE.

steps.title: Choose your original game
steps.instruction: In the launcher, choose Browse and select your own unmodified US Game Boy Advance ROM. The launcher checks for an 8 MiB file with game code AWAE and MD5 5fe47355a33e3fabec2a1607af88a404. Choose Launch Game.

warnings: The packages contain recompiled game program code. Upstream's MIT notice covers its identified sources, and upstream documents inherited code with no recorded license. The launcher reads game data from your own original ROM.

The Windows v0.3.2-beta runtime could not start on the Windows 11 build 26300 host tested by Portcove. This release could not reserve the memory range it needs for the game. See upstream for newer beta releases.

The Windows launcher saves the selected ROM path in your user registry. Windows v0.3.2-beta can read earlier settings, but beta 1 and beta 2 cannot read the newer settings it saves. Back up settings before downgrading.

data_locations: the Windows user registry entry for the original ROM path
